{{- /* Where a link to a docs page goes in the Markdown versions: the page's own index.md when it has one, so an agent that follows a link keeps reading Markdown instead of the HTML site (the docs are static files, so the server cannot pick Markdown for it). An API reference member page (a property, a method) has no index.md: its content is a section of its parent symbol's, so a link to it goes to that section, `/index.md#`. Keys and values are the URL paths of the permalinks, base path included (/docs/gooddata-ui/...), which is what page-markdown.html resolves a link to. Not .RelPermalink: with canonifyURLs it leaves the base path out. Call it once per build: partialCached "md/links.html" site. Returns a dict: page path -> Markdown version path (with the fragment for a member). */ -}} {{- $s := newScratch -}} {{- range site.Pages -}} {{- $page := . -}} {{- with .OutputFormats.Get "markdown" -}} {{- $s.SetInMap "links" (urls.Parse $page.Permalink).Path (urls.Parse .Permalink).Path -}} {{- else -}} {{- with $page.Params.parent_symbol -}} {{- with $page.CurrentSection.GetPage . -}} {{- with .OutputFormats.Get "markdown" -}} {{- $s.SetInMap "links" (urls.Parse $page.Permalink).Path (printf "%s#%s" (urls.Parse .Permalink).Path (anchorize $page.Title)) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($s.Get "links" | default dict) -}}
